items.title: Project Planning Workspace for project initiation and budget planning
items.summary: Accelerate the path from project proposal through staffing with Project Planning Workspace. AI-powered capabilities help you assess qualified sales opportunities, generate proposals, create structured project plans, produce governed budgets, and staff approved demand with qualified, available people.

items.title: Track progress with task output quantities
items.summary: Measure and track work using output quantities, also known as work quantities. Output quantities represent measurable units of work, such as kilometers of pipeline installed or cubic feet of concrete poured.

items.title: Updated labor schedule management pages
items.summary: Experience improved labor schedule management through redesigned pages that offer a streamlined flow of analysis and maintenance. New distribution level management aid in identifying gaps and over allocations, enabling faster and more accurate adjustments to labor distribution in both the near and long term.

items.title: Introduce and plan for new business
items.summary: You can create and manage member introductions for new product, customer, and organization launches by copying selected measures from existing members to target members.

items.title: Associate a technician to multiple labor resources
items.summary: Define a technician as being qualified for one or more job categories within an organization. Considered throughout the maintenance planning and execution lifecycle, this capability ensures work is assigned to qualified technicians while maintaining accurate labor tracking and reporting.

items.title: Capture quality events for returns and field service debrief
items.summary: Service Logistics supports the capture of Quality events from Work Order Charges and Reverse Logistics workbench pages. This enables users to record inspection results for debrief asset and for asset parts in defective inventory from customer returns.

items.title: Get substitution recommendations for high-risk, unreleased batches using the Batch Conformance Guide
items.summary: In process manufacturing, variability in ingredient composition can cause conformance parameter values for a batch’s primary product to fall outside the acceptable range.

items.title: Quality Assurance Workspace
items.summary: Manufacturers need to detect process variation early, before inspection trends become quality failures. With the Quality Assurance Workspace, quality teams can analyze recent inspection results, identify at-risk characteristics, review Statistical Process Control (SPC) charts, interpret statistical signals, and take follow-up action from a single guided workspace.

items.title: Manage configurations programmatically with Redwood Configurator
items.summary: Interact with Redwood Configurator using the Configuration Runtime REST service to create, update, validate, and complete configurations from external applications and integration flows.

items.title: Quality Assurance Workspace
items.summary: Manufacturers need to detect process variation early, before inspection trends become quality failures. With the Quality Assurance Workspace, quality teams can analyze recent inspection results, identify at-risk characteristics, review Statistical Process Control (SPC) charts, interpret statistical signals, and take follow-up action from a single guided workspace.

items.title: Analyze planning results using a Supply Chain Network visualization
items.summary: You can now use the Supply Chain Network visualization in supply plans and replenishment plans to explore upstream and downstream supply networks, from finished goods organizations through intermediate stocking points to supplier sites.

items.title: Collect demand history in the targeted mode by organization groups from the Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications Suite
items.summary: Collect demand history from the Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications Suite by organization groups to improve synchronization and scalability. This collection supports only organizations that are included in both the specified organization groups and organization filters and respects defined collection time ranges.

items.title: Configure default filters for page search
items.summary: You can use the Dimension Catalog's Page Search tab to configure which hierarchy member levels appear as default page-level search facets per plan type. When you edit a plan type, a drawer displays a hierarchical tree of dimensions, hierarchies, and member levels from the Hierarchies tab, with the defaults preselected.

items.title: Create a full copy of a demand plan
items.summary: You can now make a full copy of a demand plan. The full plan copy preserves the complete planning history, including archived versions, the audit trail, and planner notes, enabling traceability, faster scenario creation, better governance, and continuity across planning cycles.

items.title: Enable parallel runs for load data process during targeted refresh collections
items.summary: You can now Collect Planning Data and Load Planning Data from flat file processes in parallel by organization group. When you select an organization group with targeted or net change refresh, supported collection processes can run in parallel from the user interface, Scheduled Processes, REST service, or job sets.

items.title: Enable toolbar in pivot tables in compare mode
items.summary: You can now use a centralized toolbar in the Compare Plans view for quick access to data filters. Apply real-time filters and reusable filter sets while comparing plans, using a consistent toolbar-driven interaction model that streamlines plan comparison and reduces the need to switch context.

items.title: Export a list of measures
items.summary: You can use the Export icon on the Measures page to export the displayed measures to a Microsoft Excel-compatible file. The export includes the same columns shown on the page and preserves their order.

items.title: Export details of the plan status
items.summary: You can now use the enhanced Plan Status Details drawer to export the plan-status information. This capability helps you identify failed or delayed steps, retain execution history, and collaborate more easily with other teams.

items.title: Filter by a relative date range before or after the plan start date in visualizations
items.summary: You can now configure Redwood visualizations with relative date ranges that start and end before or after the plan start date. On the Time Members subtab on the Data tab in the properties drawer for a visualization, when you set the criteria to Relative to plan start date, the drawer includes Before and After options for both the start and end dates.

items.title: Filter by multiple product catalogs
items.summary: Use category filters in planning visualizations to select categories from the product hierarchies listed in a plan's Dimension Catalog. The Category list of values displays both the category name and the associated product hierarchy, helping you choose the right category when similar category names exist across product hierarchies.

items.title: Filter exception results by column values and show exception types based on context
items.summary: You can now apply column filters to narrow order-based and measure-based exception results, including when viewing by exception group. Filters carry over when you drill into Exceptions from pages such as Supplies and Demands, Demand Fulfillment, Resource Requirements, or a pivot table or graph, with filter conditions matched to each column's data type.

items.title: Group visualizations and drill-to-action logically
items.summary: You can now add a visualization group to the drill-to-link menu. You can easily access these visualizations through the drill-to action.

items.title: Hide any filter in the filter bar in user-specific layout
items.summary: With this update, you can hide any filter in a filter bar as part of a user-specific layout. You can personalize planning pages by removing unused filters from the view while keeping the layout tailored to your own planning work.

items.title: Improve chart, pivot table, and filter interactions
items.summary: With this update, you can see the improvements in chart, pivot table, and filter interactions for member filters, cell edits, hierarchy expansion, and mass edit.

items.title: Migrate Classic page layouts to Redwood pages and page groups
items.summary: With this update, you can migrate all Classic page layouts to Redwood layouts by running a dedicated scheduled process and reducing the need to manually recreate each page layout.

items.title: Recover deleted demand plans
items.summary: You can now recover a deleted demand plan from the Trash page when the plan is deleted inadvertently. After recovering the plan, you can verify it before continuing demand planning.

items.title: Search the audit trail for measure-value updates
items.summary: You can open the audit trail from a table cell or the Actions drawer. When opened from a cell, the audit trail keeps the cell context, including the measure name, selected levels, filter members, and filters.
